items.text: Supplies an applicable schema-valid proposal for the project directions file.
Session entry ensures freshness instead of unconditionally rebuilding or blindly reusing.
Reuse compares both catalogue and alias content digests.
Reuse also compares format version, without using producer identity.
Missing, unreadable and mismatched indexes still require rebuilding.
Lookup and post-input-write checks still ensure freshness.
Release rebuilding and completion reporting remain required.
